Fortnite x ONE PIECE: Zoro's Three-Sword Style is usable, but his outfit isn't available yet. Things to watch out for in the collaboration starting November 1st
At 11:00 PM on November 1st, Fortnite's new season, "Treasure Hunters," will begin.
The highlight of this season is the collaboration with "ONE PIECE."
The new "Crossbone Island" will feature locations like Foosha Village and Arlong Park. You will be able to fight using Luffy's Gum-Gum Fruit and Zoro's Three-Sword Style.
The content makes you want to play as the original characters, but checking the official announcement reveals some confusing details.
Even though Zoro's Three-Sword Style is usable in the new season, Zoro's costume will not be in the shop on November 1st.
Furthermore, Ace and Robin are in the Battle Pass. Chopper is not an outfit for players to wear, but a separate item called a Buddy.
